# MCP-Jobs

MCP server for job-market intelligence across Czech job portals — **6 providers**, boolean matching, 3-layer dedup, **PostgreSQL persistence**, MCP interface for AI agents. Successor to legacy scrapers — **5.8× faster**, config-driven, **189 unit tests**, production hardening.

**What it is:** an autonomously developed, iteratively hardened system — from scraping adapter through normalization, dedup and persistence to an AI-facing MCP protocol. Each layer (HTTP → scraping → normalization → matcher → dedup → persistence → MCP) is separated behind a stable boundary, so adding a new portal does not require rewriting the central pipeline.

## Key capabilities

- **6 portals** — jobs.cz, prace.cz, bazos.cz, jenprace.cz, profesia.cz, volnamista.cz (LMC network, ManpowerGroup, Seznam.cz) — 4 distinct anti-bot/layout defenses

- **8 configurable queries** — python\_ai\_engineer, ai\_llm\_engineer, mcp\_agentic, data\_engineering, devops\_ci\_cd, prumyslova\_automatizace, cnc\_cam\_automation, reverse\_engineering

- **Boolean matching** — full AND/OR/NOT/parens logic with AST parser + diacritics + LRU cache (8000→8 parses)

- **3-layer dedup** — URL canonicalization → fuzzy in-memory → DB-level cross-portal

- **Exclude lists** — word-boundary on title, substring on description (Czech inflection support)

- **Location & salary filter** — substring location match, regex salary extraction

- **Rate limiting** — 0.5s between requests (ToS compliance, clamp min 0.2s) + pages guard (max 50)

- **Boolean auto-validation** — fail-fast on malformed config

- **PostgreSQL persistence** — URL UNIQUE + ON CONFLICT dedup, run audit, graceful degradation

- **SSRF hardening** — domain allowlist (SEC-001), regression tests on dangerous targets

- **Structured logging** — per-card skip count, 0-ads alert, no silent failures

## Architecture

```
src/mcp\_jobs/  
├── config.py          \# UserConfig → PortalConfig → CategoryConfig → QueryConfig  
├── models.py          \# Ad dataclass (title, url, portal, desc, company, ...)  
├── http.py            \# HTTP client with retry, timeout, rate limiting  
├── matcher.py         \# Boolean AST evaluator + LRU cache + exclude filter + strip\_diacritics  
├── utils.py           \# normalize\_url, fuzzy\_key — central dedup normalization  
├── pipeline.py        \# SearchPipeline orchestrator (scrape → filter → results → persist)  
├── storage.py         \# Unified output (etl\_\{PROFILE\}\_\{ts\}.\{json,md,html\}) + dedup  
├── db.py              \# PostgreSQL persistence (schema.sql, upsert\_ads batched, run audit)  
├── report.py          \# Report rendering (markdown/html, priority flags, match tags)  
├── report\_style.py    \# Report CSS/HTML templates  
├── providers/         \# Portal-specific scrapers  
│   ├── base.py        \# BaseScraper ABC + detail extraction helper  
│   ├── bazos.py       \# Bazos.cz with params support (hlokalita, humkreis)  
│   ├── jobs.py        \# Jobs.cz (LMC network)  
│   ├── pracecz.py     \# Prace.cz (LMC network)  
│   ├── jenprace.py    \# Jenprace.cz  
│   ├── profesia.py    \# Profesia.cz (ManpowerGroup layout variant)  
│   └── volnamista.py  \# Volnamista.cz (Seznam.cz — anti-bot headers, JSON-LD/NEXT\_DATA)  
├── server.py          \# FastMCP instance + tool/resource/prompt registration + async job runner  
└── cli.py             \# CLI entry point (stdio MCP transport)  
data/  
├── schema.sql         \# DDL for PostgreSQL (ads, pipeline\_runs, UNIQUE url, fuzzy columns)  
└── query\_store.json   \# Query output persistence  
output/                \# ETL outputs etl\_\{PROFILE\}\_\{ts\}.\{json,md,html\}  
scripts/  
├── run\_etl.py           \# Basic ETL runner  
├── run\_etl\_metrics.py   \# ETL runner with per-provider timing  
├── run\_livetests.py     \# Live test runner (structured results into data/)  
├── db.ps1               \# DB operations (restart, psql, logs, dedup check)  
└── healthcheck.py       \# Healthcheck (dry-mode without DB)  
docker-compose.yml     \# PostgreSQL 16 (volume, schema.sql init, healthcheck)
```

## Engineering highlights

The system is designed so that failures are visible and measurable, not silent:

- **HTTP 200 proves transport success, not semantic success.** Provider telemetry tracks the chain `HTTP success → cards parsed → valid ads → detail fetch → final output`. A page with 0 cards on page>1 = end-of-list (INFO); on page 1 = layout change (ERROR) — both logged distinctly.

- **Dedup trade-off is observable.** Fuzzy dedup is a heuristic (title+company+location normalize to identity) — collisions are logged, not hidden.

- **Cache ≠ persistence.** A detail cache prevents repeated HTTP work; PostgreSQL preserves state. Runtime job state is lost on restart; persisted data survives.

- **Bounded concurrency.** Background executor isolates long-running scraping from the MCP request timeout; job-state model `pending → running → done/error`.

- **Evidence-driven iteration.** Regression tests are built around discovered failure modes: `identify concrete failure mode → patch boundary → regression test → preserve invariant`. SSRF, malformed config, dedup collisions, bot detection, test-ordering pollution.

> Deep reasoning, dedup audit and provider resilience case studies live in `docs/` (see below).

## Quick start

```
\# Install  
python -m venv .venv  
.venv\\Scripts\\activate  
pip install -e ".\[dev\]"  
   
\# Configure  
copy config.yaml config\_local.yaml  
\# Edit portals, queries, excludes as needed (see Configuration)  
   
\# PostgreSQL (optional, for persistence)  
docker compose up -d  
copy .env.example .env   \# set DATABASE\_URL=postgres://mcpjobs:mcpjobs@localhost:5432/mcpjobs  
\# or: scripts\\db.ps1 (restart, psql, logs)  
   
\# Tests (189 tests; DB tests run against mcpjobs\_test, skipped otherwise)  
pytest tests/ -v  
   
\# ETL pipeline  
python scripts\\run\_etl.py  
\# Fallback profile (legacy manual queries):  
python scripts\\run\_etl.py --config config\_legacy\_manual.yaml
```

## Configuration

All personalization is in `config.yaml` — no personal data in code:

```
user: "default"  
profile: "AI-NATIVE"  
   
pipeline:  
  max\_workers: 3  
  request\_delay: 0.5  
   
portals:  
  jobs:  
    enabled: true  
    categories:  
      - url: "https://www.jobs.cz/prace/praha/"  
        pages: 20  
  profesia:  
    enabled: true  
    categories:  
      - url: "https://www.profesia.cz/prace/praha/"  
        pages: 10  
   
queries:  
  python\_ai\_engineer:  
    boolean: "(python AND (ai OR ml OR data OR vyvojar OR programator OR inzenyr OR engineer OR developer)) NOT (lektor OR kurz OR skoleni)"  
    exclude: \["agentura", "nabizim", "hledam praci"\]  
    locations: \["praha", "remote", "home office", "domova", "hybrid", "dálkově"\]  
    portals: \["jobs", "pracecz", "jenprace", "profesia", "volnamista"\]
```

> **Note:** The boolean parser is **strict-only** — implicit AND is not supported. `"python developer"` must be written as `"python AND developer"`. Use `validate\_boolean()` for syntax checking.

## Pipeline flow

```
1. \_scrape\_all() → pool [Ad] (all portals, categories, pages; 0.5s delay between requests)  
2. For each query:  
   ├── Portal filter (ad.portal IN query.portals?)  
   ├── Boolean match (evaluate\_boolean AST — LRU cached, 1× parse per unique query)  
   ├── Exclude filter (has\_exclude\_terms)  
   ├── Location filter (substring)  
   └── Salary filter (number \>= min\_salary)  
3. Dedup (URL canonical → fuzzy in-memory → DB-level cross-portal)  
4. Detail fetch (parallel, bounded) — only for candidates requiring description  
5. Returns dict[str, list[Ad]]
```

## Comparison with legacy scrapers

| Metric | Legacy | MCP-Jobs | Improvement |
| - | - | - | - |
| Pipeline time | ~210 s | **~36 s** | **5.8× faster** |
| Raw ads scraped | ~500 | **1 073** | 2× more data |
| Per-provider bazos | ~80 s | **~12 s** | **6.7× faster** |
| Per-provider jobs | ~40 s | **~8 s** | **5.0× faster** |
| Per-provider pracecz | ~60 s | **~16 s** | **3.8× faster** |
| Unit tests | 0 | **189** | — |
| Matching | AND-only, first-match-wins | **Boolean AST + LRU cache** | full logic |
| Diacritics | manual mapping | **NFKD normalization** | automatic |
| Error handling | `except: continue` (silent) | **structured logging + skip count** | no silent failures |
| Dedup | URL only | **URL + fuzzy + DB cross-portal** | 3 layers |
| Detail fetch | sequential | **parallel** (bounded) | — |
| Output | CSV+MD per portal | **unified JSON/MD/HTML + PostgreSQL** | dual-write |
| Protocol | none | **MCP** (tools, resources, prompts) | AI-native |
| Security | none | **domain allowlist** (SSRF) | hardening |
| Bazos subdomains | broken (www vs prace) | **automatic detection** | — |

## MCP interface

### Tools

| Tool | Description |
| - | - |
| `health\_check` | Server status and version |
| `search\_jobs\_v2` | Boolean search across CZ portals (pages guard: max 50) |
| `search\_from\_config` | Full pipeline from YAML file path |
| `search\_from\_yaml` | Full pipeline from inline YAML content |
| `search\_status` | Status of background search job (async pipeline) |
| `list\_portals` | Available portals and categories |


### Resources (L2) & Prompts (L3)

- **L2 Resources** — `mcp-jobs://ads/list`, `mcp-jobs://ads/\{query\_id\}`, `mcp-jobs://ads/\{query\_id\}/report`

- **L3 Prompts** — `search\_expert` (natural language → boolean query + YAML snippet)

- **L4 Streaming** — planned

## Known Limitations

- **Rate limiting**: 0.5s delay = 36s pipeline. Required for ToS compliance.

- **Double scrape**: `SearchPipeline.run()` always rescrapes internally — existing pool cannot be injected

- **Description matching**: word boundaries DISABLED on description (intentional — Czech inflection)

- **Location filter**: substring matching (no geocoding), sufficient for "Praha"

- **Salary filter**: heuristic number extraction (varying formats across portals)

- **Fuzzy dedup**: heuristic — false positives possible (company, two roles, same title+location); collisions are logged

- **Runtime job state**: in-memory — server restart loses in-flight jobs

- **Security**: threat model not documented — must be added before public release

- **Domain allowlist**: SEC-001 SSRF protection — 6 allowed domains (bazos.cz, jobs.cz, prace.cz, jenprace.cz, profesia.cz, volnamista.cz)
